description: Per-merchant PROGRAM (ad) vs SITE (organic) funnel with cost-per-click for a marketplace over a period, one row per merchant (os_client_id + merchant name). PROGRAM metrics (spend, clicks, impressions, viewproducts, add2carts) come from client_vendor_channel_performance_facts; SITE metrics (viewproducts, add2carts) come from monetize_merchant_facts. Spend is converted to the marketplace currency; CPC (spend / clicks) is computed per merchant. Filter by channel to isolate PLA (os_product_ads) vs Display (guaranteed_display_ads / auction_display_ads).

os_client_id.description: OnlineSales client id of the merchant (working id for internal analysis).

merchant_id.description: Merchant (seller) id (working id for internal analysis).

channel.description: Ad program channel: os_product_ads (PLA), guaranteed_display_ads / auction_display_ads (Display). Use as a filter to scope the PROGRAM funnel to a program type; SITE (organic) metrics are the merchant's full organic funnel regardless of channel.

spend.description: PROGRAM ad spend for this merchant, converted to the marketplace currency.

clicks.description: PROGRAM ad clicks for this merchant.

impressions.description: PROGRAM ad impressions for this merchant.

cpc.description: Cost per click = spend / clicks for this merchant, in the marketplace currency.

program_viewproducts.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) product views for this merchant.

program_add2carts.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) add-to-carts for this merchant.

site_viewproducts.description: SITE (organic, total store) product views for this merchant.

site_add2carts.description: SITE (organic, total store) add-to-carts for this merchant.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM ( SELECT mmd.client_id AS os_client_id, mmd.merchant_name AS merchant_name, mmd.merchant_id AS merchant_id, cvcpf.channel AS channel, SUM(cvcpf.cost * scc.conversion_factor) AS spend, SUM(cvcpf.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(cvcpf.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_viewproduct) AS program_viewproducts, SUM(cvcpf.program_per_click_timestamp_add_to_cart) AS program_add2carts FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.client_vendor_channel_performance_facts` AS cvcpf INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.clients` AS clients ON clients.client_id = cvcpf.client_id AND clients.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mc.agency_id = clients.agency_id AND clients.client_id != mc.marketplace_client_id AND mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.monetize_merchant_dimensions` AS mmd ON mmd.merchant_id = clients.seller_id AND mmd.agency_id = clients.agency_id LEFT JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.static_currency_conversion` AS scc ON scc.from_currency = cvcpf.currency AND scc.to_currency = mc.currency WHERE cvcpf.vendor = 'os_ads' AND cvcpf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) AS base LEFT JOIN ( SELECT mmf.merchant_id AS merchant_id, SUM(mmf.total_sok_viewproducts) AS site_viewproducts, SUM(mmf.total_sok_add2carts) AS site_add2carts FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.monetize_merchant_facts` AS mmf INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON mmf.agency_id = mc.agency_id AND mmf.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id AND mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' WHERE mmf.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND mmf.date >= '__START_DATE_1__' AND mmf.date <= '__END_DATE_1__' GROUP BY 1 ) AS org ON base.merchant_id = org.merchant_id WHERE base.merchant_id IS NOT NULL AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
